question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**perpetually**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes the lifestyle of arboreal apes who were consistently or constantly engaged in activities such as gymnastics.
 
• "Perpetually" means continuously or without interruption, which fits the context of their constant engagement in gymnastics.
